Strategy: Bins that become unable to fit another item of the same size after placement are filled first, tightest among them, while bins staying reusable rank below; the rule spends capacity that would otherwise be stranded. It differs from Best Fit whenever a reusable bin is tighter than a dead one. It may help by using up doomed capacity early, or fail by sacrificing reusable bins for marginal gains.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [((100 - (r - item)) if r - item < item else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
